title: Correct AC-9 wording: no --strict in pinned claude CLI
context: Frozen spec AC-9 says 'claude plugin validate --strict (available locally)'. The pinned claude CLI (2.1.47) has no --strict flag (claude plugin validate --help shows only <path>). The implementation correctly uses plain 'validate' (fail-loud, exit 1 on error); no validation strength is lost because no stricter mode exists. This is a spec-wording inaccuracy, not a behavior change.

options.label: Correct AC-9 to drop the --strict claim and state plain validate is used (matches reality)
Keep AC-9 wording and require --strict once a CLI supports it (leaves the spec inaccurate today)

rationale: Pinned claude CLI has no --strict; plain validate is used with no loss of strength. Correct AC-9 wording to match reality.
